# Quake shareware data

Unmodified Quake 1.06 shareware game data (episode one), copyright id Software.
This is game data, separate from quakegeneric's GPL-licensed engine.

- Source: id Software's FTP archive, as mirrored at
  https://ftp.gwdg.de/pub/misc/ftp.idsoftware.com/idstuff/quake/quake106.zip
- Archive SHA-256: `ec6c9d34b1ae0252ac0066045b6611a7919c2a0d78a3a66d9387a8f597553239`
- Archive MD5: `8cee4d03ee092909fdb6a4f84f0c1357`
- Member: `resource.1` (LHA, SHA-256
  `c192c9c71bee41750dd7d14c99378766d61e077977b9d13d1a457b8d9eabe34a`), containing
  `ID1/PAK0.PAK`, `SLICNSE.TXT` and `LICINFO.TXT`
- `pak0.pak` SHA-256: `35a9c55e5e5a284a159ad2a62e0e8def23d829561fe2f54eb402dbc0a9a946af`
- `pak0.pak` MD5: `5906e5998fc3d896ddaf5e6a62e03abb`

`SLICNSE.TXT` is the complete shareware end-user license and `LICINFO.TXT` id's
summary of its license terms, both byte-identical to the archive. Keep them with
the data. Section 6 of the license lets end users distribute the shareware free
of charge only, as a whole, and lets online providers distribute it only in
compressed form with the agreement attached. It permits no commercial use. The
owner accepted shipping this pak with both texts in the image (2026-10-04). It
does not cover the registered or retail paks.

No local data changes. The pak is stored under Quake's lowercase name; image
staging copies it to `share/quake/id1/pak0.pak` with the license texts under
`share/licenses/quake-shareware/`.
